destinations.name: Marrakech
destinations.tagline: Souks, riads and the gateway to the Sahara
destinations.description: Lose yourself in the medina, sip mint tea on a rooftop and head out to the Atlas Mountains and the Agafay desert.

destinations.name: Agadir
destinations.tagline: Beaches, surf and the road to the Anti-Atlas
destinations.description: Agadir's long sandy bay is Morocco's beach capital, with the surf villages of Taghazout and Tamraght just up the coast and Paradise Valley in the hills behind. It is also a starting point for tours to the desert and the Anti-Atlas.

destinations.name: Fes
destinations.tagline: The medieval medina and the road to Merzouga
destinations.description: Fes el-Bali is the largest car-free medina in the world: 9,000 lanes of tanneries, madrasas and craft workshops. It is also the closest imperial city to the Erg Chebbi dunes, making it the classic starting point for Sahara tours that end in Marrakech.

destinations.name: Tangier
destinations.description: A ferry ride from Spain, Tangier is the natural start of a north-to-south journey: Chefchaouen's blue streets, the imperial cities, the Sahara and finally Marrakech.

destinations.name: Casablanca
destinations.description: Most international flights land in Casablanca. Start here with the Hassan II Mosque, then head inland to Rabat, the imperial cities, the desert and the mountains.

destinations.name: Chefchaouen
destinations.tagline: The Blue Pearl of the Rif mountains
destinations.description: Every wall, step and doorway in Chefchaouen's medina is washed in shades of blue. Wander quiet alleys, browse leather and weaving workshops, drink fresh orange juice in the squares and hike up to the Spanish Mosque for sunset.

destinations.name: Ouarzazate
destinations.description: Ouarzazate sits between the High Atlas and the Sahara, surrounded by kasbahs and film studios. It is the natural base for trips to Aït Benhaddou, the Draa Valley and the dunes.

destinations.name: Errachidia
destinations.tagline: The closest airport to the Merzouga dunes
destinations.description: Errachidia's Moulay Ali Cherif airport is about two hours from Erg Chebbi, making it the fastest way into the Sahara. Tours start at the airport or your hotel and head straight for the dunes.

destinations.name: Merzouga
destinations.description: The village at the foot of Erg Chebbi, Morocco's highest dunes. Base for camel treks, quad biking, sandboarding and nights in desert camps.

tours.title: 2-Day Marrakech to Zagora Desert Tour
tours.meetingPoint: Pickup from your hotel or riad in Marrakech
tours.excerpt: A short taste of the desert: Aït Benhaddou, the Draa Valley and a night in a Zagora camp.
tours.description: Short on time? This two-day trip takes you over the High Atlas to the Draa Valley and the edge of the Sahara at Zagora. Ride a camel at sunset and sleep in a desert camp, then return to Marrakech the next evening.

itinerary.details: Cross the Tizi n'Tichka pass, visit Aït Benhaddou and follow the Draa Valley to Zagora for a sunset camel ride and a night in camp.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Zagora to Marrakech
itinerary.details: Sunrise in the desert, then the drive back through Ouarzazate, arriving in Marrakech in the evening.

tours.title: 4-Day Agadir to Merzouga Desert Tour
tours.meetingPoint: Pickup from your hotel in Agadir
tours.excerpt: Agadir to the Erg Chebbi dunes and on to Marrakech, through kasbahs and gorges.
tours.description: A one-way journey from the Atlantic to the highest dunes in Morocco, finishing in Marrakech. Pass Taroudant and Ouarzazate, sleep in the Dadès Valley and in a camp in Erg Chebbi.
highlights: Night in the Erg Chebbi dunes

itinerary.title: Day 1: Agadir to Ouarzazate
itinerary.details: Taroudant and the Anti-Atlas to Ouarzazate.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Ouarzazate to Merzouga
itinerary.details: Valley of Roses and the Todra Gorge. Ride camels into the dunes for sunset, then dinner, Berber drumming and a night in a desert camp.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Merzouga to the Dadès Valley
itinerary.details: Sunrise on the dunes, then back west to the Dadès.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Dadès to Marrakech
itinerary.details: Aït Benhaddou and the Tizi n'Tichka pass.

tours.title: Surf Lesson in Taghazout
tours.meetingPoint: Pickup from your hotel in Agadir
tours.excerpt: Learn to surf on the friendly beach breaks north of Agadir with a certified instructor.
tours.description: A beginner surf lesson on one of the Atlantic beaches around Taghazout. Your instructor picks the spot for the day's waves, teaches you on the sand and stays with you in the water.

itinerary.title: Pickup
itinerary.details: From Agadir, Tamraght or Taghazout.

itinerary.title: On the sand
itinerary.details: Safety, paddling and pop-up practice.

itinerary.title: In the water
itinerary.details: About two hours of surfing with your instructor.

tours.title: Paradise Valley Hike from Agadir
tours.meetingPoint: Pickup from your hotel in Agadir
tours.excerpt: Walk through palm-lined gorges to turquoise rock pools in the Atlas foothills.
tours.description: Drive 45 minutes into the hills behind Agadir to Paradise Valley. Walk along the river through palm groves and oleanders to natural pools where you can swim, then have lunch by the water.

itinerary.title: Pickup
itinerary.details: Leave Agadir at 9 am.

itinerary.title: Walk
itinerary.details: About two hours along the valley.

itinerary.title: Pools
itinerary.details: Free time to swim and relax.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.details: Back in Agadir in the afternoon.

tours.title: Dune Buggy Ride in Merzouga
tours.meetingPoint: Buggy station in Merzouga
tours.excerpt: Drive a two-seater buggy over the dunes of Erg Chebbi with a guide.
tours.description: Swap the camel for horsepower. After a short briefing, drive a two-seater buggy behind your guide through the dunes and the black desert around Erg Chebbi, stopping for photos at the top.

itinerary.title: Briefing
itinerary.details: Helmet, goggles and a practice lap.

itinerary.title: Ride
itinerary.details: One hour through the dunes and the hamada.
